entries.candidate: Koto Sengoku 3-chome data centre ((仮称)江東区千石三丁目計画), status refresh to permitted
entries.reason: Removed by verifier worker 1 (jp-kanto-pref-p5, 27 October 2026): the permit cannot be stated with its authority and reference. Koto City's Building Coordination Section reference 参考1 of 16 October 2026 (https://www.city.koto.lg.jp/650000/documents/081016boumachi_sankou1.pdf; local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/koto-081016-sankou1.pdf, sha256 5308e703...; government_record, 11 days old) says the operator applied for building confirmation to a designated confirmation and inspection body (指定確認検査機関) on 24 July 2026, and that the body issued the confirmation certificate (確認済証) on 27 August 2026. The identity of the plan is solid: same address 千石3丁目2番, 9,478.42 m2 site, 22,640 m2, 51.4 m, five storeys as the existing record. The record names neither the issuing body nor the certificate number, so the consent has a date but no authority and no reference. Every permitted record in the Atlas carries a permit reference. The Japanese building-confirmation precedent (TECRA Ome building B) gives the body and number (Japan ERI ERI-26012911). Earlier holds (cn-north-p1 GDS Horinger North Zone, thirty-fourth China Mobile Lingang) also refused permitted where the permit number or authority was unpublished. No appeal (審査請求) or withdrawal is reported. The September 2026 works start is only a schedule, so no construction stage is supported. The existing record stays announced as of 9 October 2026. The same reference would support an announced refresh as of 16 October 2026, but that adds only seven days and was not made.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated primary record (within the window) that names the designated confirmation and inspection body and the 確認済証 number for the Sengoku 3-chome data-centre building. Possible sources: a later Koto City committee reference, the ward's 建築計画概要書 register entry, or a published photograph of the 建築基準法による確認済 site sign. Then refresh to permitted as of that record's date (strictly newer than 9 October 2026), keeping the reviewed project locator. Alternatively, a dated ward or operator record of works on site supports a construction stage.

entries.candidate: Kodaira 天神町データセンター — (仮称)小平市天神町ビル新築工事, 小平市天神町一丁目59番1 (land-use concept by 合同会社SSG10; reported DayOne Kodaira site), Kodaira, Tokyo
entries.reason: Status evidence is in window, the locator is not. Kodaira City's website is down after a system failure (temporary page, last updated 20 October 2026) and the city now posts notices through its LoGo Form channel. Its statement 天神町データセンター建設に関する市の立場と事業主への要望について (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/logoform-kodaira-20261022.pdf, sha256 fc6aa907..., one page, PDF created 22 October 2026, file path dated 20261022) names the Tenjin-cho data centre. It says the city handled it under its development-procedure ordinance and cannot stop a lawful project. It says the operator's construction briefing on 30 August 2026 ended without the works being explained, and that the city has sent the operator a list of requests. The flow chart published with it (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/logoform-kodaira-20261022-flow.pdf, sha256 a9a1a97b...) gives the land-use concept notification of 9 August 2024 (category: building of 10,000 m2 or more floor area), the briefings of 18 September and 5 October 2024, 18 written opinions, the coordination meeting of 18 December 2024, the land-use council of 28 January 2025 and the mayor's guidance of 27 February 2025. The city's page of coordination-meeting records, read through an Internet Archive copy because the city site is down (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/ia-kodaira-073998.html, snapshot 22 January 2026, page updated 25 September 2025, sha256 0c82bc5f...), records the 18 December 2024 meeting for proponent 合同会社SSG10, site 小平市天神町一丁目59番1, land use データセンター. That date bridges the 2026 statement to lot 59-1. These records would support announced status as of 22 October 2026 without naming an operator; DayOne is not named in any official record read. No admissible locator was found. GSI address search for 天神町一丁目59 returns only the 天神町一丁目 chome point (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/gsi-addr-kodaira-tenjin1-59.json), which is excluded. The MOJ/AIGID public-coordinate parcel file for Kodaira (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/s3-list-13211.xml; dataset page geospatial-aigid-moj-13211.html) converts only public-coordinate maps, and earlier lanes found no 天神町 parcels in it. The 2024 coordination-meeting minutes are not archived; an Internet Archive CDX listing of that file directory (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/ia-cdx-kodaira-073998-files.json) holds only a 2022 file. The developer's linked materials (Linktree page disallowed by robots.txt; Google Drive files whose owner disabled download) were not read. The city map system was not used because it requires accepting terms.
entries.reopen_condition: An official or developer site map, lot geometry or address point for 小平市天神町一丁目59番1. Possible sources: the restored Kodaira development-guidance pages or the 2024 land-use concept notice; council material with a location map; MOJ registry-map XML for 天神町 registered to GSI tiles. Then admit the data-centre building as announced as of 22 October 2026 (or a newer stage, such as a building confirmation or a works observation) with the city statement as status source and the archived city page as identity bridge. Name DayOne or Digital Land IV Japan only with a primary bridge.

entries.candidate: Kawasaki Saiwai-ku data-centre buildings in CASBEE Kawasaki: (仮称)HAKUBA新築工事 and HAKUBA DC2A/DC2B, 北加瀬二丁目585番1号; (仮称)GOTEMBA新築工事 (Phase 1, 2), 新小倉545番50
entries.reason:
Kawasaki City's CASBEE open-data files list the following data-centre buildings in Saiwai-ku:
- FY R5 (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/kawasaki-casbee-FYR05.csv, sha256 665378bc...): (仮称)HAKUBA新築工事, 北加瀬二丁目585番1号. Site 22,937 m2, floor area 15,152 m2, steel, five storeys, use data centre, dates 2024/11/30 and 2024/11/7.
- FY R6 (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/kawasaki-casbee-FYR06.csv, sha256 a311a0e8...): (仮称)HAKUBA DC2A2B新築工事, DC2A and DC2B buildings on part of the same lot. About 15,083 m2 each, planned completion 1 April 2029 (R11.4.1).
- FY R3 (local_data/country-research-jp-kanto-pref-p5/kawasaki-casbee-FYR03.csv, sha256 62a22613...): (仮称)GOTEMBA新築工事 (Phase 1, 2), 新小倉545番50. Office (data centre), 17,348 m2.
None names an owner or operator. None is in the Atlas, a hold, a claim or a pending fragment. The FY R7 and R8 files list no data centre. No in-window record of any of these buildings was found, and Kawasaki's environmental-assessment pages list no data-centre case.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window operator or Kawasaki City record of a named HAKUBA or GOTEMBA building's stage (construction, completion, operation), plus a lot geometry (MOJ parcels for 北加瀬二丁目585-1 or 新小倉545-50) with identity review.
